results.snippet: One weakness of human-robot interaction (HRI) research is the lack of reproducible results, due to the lack of standardised benchmarks. In this work we introduce a multi-user multi-robot multi-goal multi-device manipulation benchmark (M4Bench), a flexible HRI platform in which multiple users can direct either a single—or multiple—simulated robots to perform a multi-goal pick-and-place task. Our software exposes a web-based visual interface, with support for mouse, keyboard, gamepad, eye tracker and electromyograph/electroencephalograph (EMG/EEG) user inputs. It can be further extended using n…

An Open-World Predictive Architecture Beside a Vision-Language-Action Model: Declared Rules, Prediction and Repair for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) turn camera images and an instruction into robot motions. They keep no explicit model of the world: they cannot say what a step should achieve, notice that it did not, or be held to a rule. We place an open-world predictive architecture (OWPA) beside an unmodified VLA. A language model writes a declared world model of the task as readable rules; a deterministic engine runs it to plan and to predict the facts each step should produce; a monitor compares prediction and scene after every action chunk, re-instructs a stalled policy and repairs rules that prove…

report_md:
# 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿增量快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-16（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA  
**检索源数量**：36 条可引用来源（含论文、预印本、GitHub 仓库、期刊文章、会议论文）

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 核心增量判断
近 1-2 年，**世界模型在机器人操作中的定位发生范式迁移**：从“任务专用动力学预测”向“通用预测性基础设施”演进 [1][2]；同时出现**面向细粒度操作的世界模型**（IRASim）[3]、**显式规则驱动的世界模型旁路架构**（OWPA）[4]、以及**多智能体/人机协同操作的标准化基准**（M4Bench）[5]。上述进展均为 2025-2026 年新增，相对 2023 年前以“视频预测/单任务动力学学习”为主的基线构成**显著增量**。

### 1.2 关键进展条目（带证据四轴）

| 进展 | 时间 | 机构/来源 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 | 说明 |
